HELLO, WE’RE LR GAMES

We’re Laxmi Ramesh Games, an independent mobile game studio in India. We make colorful puzzle and casual games built around simple ideas and satisfying discoveries.

From finding the right word to putting the last tile in place, we love turning small moments into something fun.
